job_description:
Why choose between doing meaningful work and having a fulfilling life? At MITRE, you can have both. That's because MITRE people are committed to tackling our nation's toughest challenges—and we're committed to the long-term well-being of our employees. MITRE is different from most technology companies. We are a not-for-profit corporation chartered to work for the public interest, with no commercial conflicts to influence what we do. The R&D centers we operate for the government create lasting impact in fields as diverse as cybersecurity, healthcare, aviation, defense, and enterprise transformation. We're making a difference every day—working for a safer, healthier, and more secure nation and world. Our workplace reflects our values. We offer competitive benefits, exceptional professional development opportunities, and a culture of innovation that embraces diversity, inclusion, flexibility, collaboration, and career growth. If this sounds like the choice you want to make, then choose MITRE—and make a difference with us.

Department Summary:

The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) IT Transformation Department (P822) is seeking a motivated and creative Artificial Intelligence Engineer with both technical and functional experience relevant to our department work programs. P822 provides robotic processing engineering (RPA), intelligent automation (IA) and artificial intelligence (AI) expertise primarily to the IRS, and as directed, to other federal agencies under the FFRDC Center for Government Effectiveness and Modernization (CGEM). The AI Engineer supports the IRS in navigating and implementing the full gamut of RPA, iA and AI technologies and processes, including conceptualization, design, development and operations. We help our sponsors solve critical RPA, IA and AI challenges while serving as their thought leader and trusted advisor.

Roles and Responsibilities:
• Builds, deploys, implements and/or modifies machine intelligence applications, including digital agents (e.g., chatbots), pattern recognition applications, (e.g., image, text, speech recognition) and classification
• Employs a combination of dataflow programming or pre-trained algorithms from an existing AI framework (e.g., TensorFlow, Caffe, MXNet, Cognitive Toolkit, Torch) but may also develop own scripts and algorithms in C++, Go, Java, Python, or equivalent languages
• Adapts artificial intelligence, including machine learning, to areas such as virtual/augmented reality, robotics, command and control, decision support, planning and other areas.
• Serves as RPA, IA, and/or AI Project Leader across a diverse portfolio of IRS sponsors
• Establishes and nurtures lasting relationships with IRS sponsors, acting as thought leader and trusted advisor

Basic Qualifications:
• Requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience
• Demonstrated experience with the design, development, and implementation of RPA, IA, and/or AI solutions
• Demonstrated experience in the delivery of omnichannel chatbots in support of IRS call or contact centers, including telephony integration services
• Demonstrated experience with the design, development, and implementation of large language models (LLMs) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities
• Demonstrated ability to implement an AI framework (e.g., TensorFlow, Caffe, MXNet, Cognitive Toolkit, Torch) and/or develop own scripts and algorithms in C++, Go, Java, Python, or equivalent languages.
• Demonstrated ability to establish an RPA, IA, AI sandbox environment to conduct proofs of concept or pilots
• Demonstrated ability to implement RPA technologies such as UiPath and Pega RPA
• Keen analytical insight with the ability to create and communicate feasible recommendations to the sponsor across RPA, IA, and AI technologies
• Project leadership, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills
• Self-motivated, curious, and collaborative, with a passion to learn new technologies and develop new skills
• Ability to obtain an IRS Suitability (Minimum Background Investigation)
• This position requires a minimum of 50% hybrid on-site

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with IRS RPA, IA, and/or AI solution implementation
• Experience with IRS organizations and supporting sponsors
• Active IRS Clearance (Minimum Background Investigation)

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):
Suitability - IRS

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):
None

Hybrid

Job Description Summary
GE Healthcare, a leading medical technology company, is at the forefront of innovation in healthcare. At the centralized AI organization, we are innovating LLM and GenAI solutions that leverage multimodal health data for various downstream tasks. Our commitment to advancing patient care is rooted in cutting-edge technology and a collaborative, dynamic work environment.

Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Manager – Clinical Data Intelligence to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in leading the data collection, data analysis and quality check, annotation, and data usage discussions with data providers and the legal team. The successful candidate will have a strong background in clinical data management, hands-on skills and experience in health data analysis including data annotation and quality check, a keen understanding of regulatory requirements, and the ability to drive excellence in data-related processes.

Job Description

Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage the end-to-end clinical data lifecycle, from collection to annotation based on clinical guidelines, ensuring high data quality and integrity and maintain a high velocity in delivery.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data collection strategies, protocols, and standards.
• Oversee the development and implementation of quality control measures to ensure accurate and reliable data.
• Engage with data providers to establish effective partnerships and facilitate data acquisition processes.
• Lead discussions with the legal department to address data usage agreements, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
• Stay abreast of industry trends, regulations, and best practices related to clinical data management.
• Provide strategic guidance on data-related decisions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory standards.

Qualifications:
• Advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., health informatics, bioinformatics, data science, etc.)
• In-depth knowledge and extensive hands-on experiment with data annotation based on clinical guideline, clinical data analysis and quality check.
• In-depth understanding of healthcare data standards, privacy regulations, and ethical considerations.
• Proven experience (3+ years) in clinical data management, with a focus on data quality, annotation, and regulatory compliance.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to facilitate discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience in negotiating and drafting data usage agreements and contracts.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving priorities.
• Customer-centric and can have strong collaboration with internal data users.

For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $206,448.00-$309,672.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

job_description:
Vice President, Artificial Intelligence (AI)

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Vice President of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to lead our AI initiatives in support of our vision and transformational goals. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of AI strategies, skill sets, technologies, data, and operating model considerations. They will be responsible for developing and implementing AI-driven solutions to enhance Acxiom’s products and services in support of our clients.
• This role can be located almost anywhere in the U.S.

What You Will Do:

AI Strategy Development: Lead the development and execution of AI strategies aligned with Acxiom’s objectives and business plan. Identify opportunities to leverage AI technologies to optimize business performance, enhance customer engagement, and drive revenue growth.

AI Solution Implementation: Lead the design and implementation of AI-driven solutions for data-driven marketing campaigns. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI technologies into existing marketing platforms and processes effectively.

Market Analysis: Keeping abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitors' AI strategies. Conducting market research to identify potential areas for AI application and innovation.

Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Establish KPIs and metrics to measure the performance and effectiveness of AI-driven marketing initiatives. Monitor campaign performance closely and identify opportunities for optimization through AI-powered algorithms and techniques.

Communication and Advocacy: Serving as a spokesperson and advocate for AI within the organization, as well as externally with clients, partners, regulators, and the broader community. Articulating the value proposition of AI and promoting a culture of innovation and learning.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with external and internal stakeholders, including IPG, products, marketing, sales, IT, and senior management, to align AI initiatives with business goals and priorities. Communicate effectively to ensure buy-in and support for AI projects across the organization.

Partnerships and Alliances : Identifying and fostering strategic partnerships with external organizations, such as technology vendors, research institutions, and startups, to leverage expertise, access to resources, and accelerate AI innovation.

Compliance and Ethical Considerations: Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and ethical guidelines in the development and deployment of AI solutions. Implement best practices for data governance and security to protect customer information and maintain trust.

What You Will Have:

+ Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

+ Proven experience (10+ years) in AI, machine learning, data analytics, and strategy, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

+ Strong technical expertise in AI technologies, including natural language processing, computer vision, predictive analytics, and recommendation systems.

+ Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Java, and experience with AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.

+ Demonstrated success in developing and implementing AI-driven solutions in a corporate marketing environment, resulting in measurable business impact.

+ Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

+ Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and a focus on driving results and continuous improvement.

job_description:
U.S. News & World Report is a multifaceted digital media company dedicated to helping citizens, consumers, business leaders and policy officials make important decisions in their lives. We publish independent reporting, rankings, data journalism and advice that has earned the trust of our readers and users for nearly 90 years. Our platforms on usnews.com include Education, Health, Money, Travel, Cars, News and 360 Reviews.

We reach more than 40 million people monthly during moments when they are most in need of expert advice and motivated to act on that advice directly on our platforms. Our signature franchises include our “Best” series of consumer guides on colleges, graduate schools, hospitals, diets, cars, financial services and more. These guides provide an easy-to-digest list for consumers to better understand and compare when making their decisions. We continue to publish annual guides of the authoritative Best Colleges and Best Hospitals rankings on our website and in print. And our U.S. News Live flagship conferences highlight important national conversations including Healthcare of Tomorrow and Healthiest Communities.

We believe in having a broad range of talent and backgrounds at U.S. News. We strive to maintain a welcoming workplace where everyone is given an opportunity to succeed and contribute to their fullest. Learn more about our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiative.

Your role in helping us shape the future:

We are seeking a talented and passionate AI Software Developer to join our team and drive the development of the next generation of AI-powered applications. In this role, you will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of AI software development, from designing and building algorithms to testing and deploying them in production.

Are you up to the challenge?
• Integrate AI models into existing or new software systems
• Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and well-documented code
• Implement scalable and efficient AI-enhanced solutions that can handle large volumes of data.
• Test and debug AI-augmented software to ensure accuracy and reliability
• Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in AI research and development
• Collaborate with Product managers, designers, and other software developers

You should definitely have:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience in developing AI-powered applications and solutions.
• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
• Hands-on experience with popular AI application frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch etc.
• Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, AI safety, and LLM model evaluation.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think creatively.
• Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
• Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

What it’s like to work with us:

Talent is our best asset!
• We invest in people with passion and potential who understand U.S. News’ dedication to our consumers.
• Entrepreneurial, mission-driven culture with core values of quality and integrity
• Focus on fostering personal and professional growth
• Competitive benefits including paid vacation time, medical, tuition reimbursement, and training
• Collaborative Work Environment : Fun, diverse, inclusive and ambitious co-workers.

job_description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

We care deeply about transforming lives with AMD technology to enrich our industry, our communities, and the world. Our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences – the building blocks for the data center, artificial intelligence, PCs, gaming and embedded. Underpinning our mission is the AMD culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges. We strive for execution excellence while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives.

AMD together we advance_

THE ROLE:

You will be responsible for developing and coordinating AI-focused thought leadership content that resonates with key audiences. This role involves translating the corporate narrative into compelling messaging for various platforms, including blogs, speeches, reports, and both long and short-form content. You will also copy edit and proofread documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency. Additionally, you will help produce campaign debriefs, compile regular reports, and calculate ROI to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities. A proactive and positive approach along with close stakeholder collaboration will be essential as you seek continuous improvements in all aspects of AMD's AI marketing activities.

THE PERSON:

You are a detailed-oriented marketing specialist with an ability to convey AI concepts through engaging and accessible content. Your aptitude in writing and editing allows you to craft clear and influential thought leadership materials. You thrive in a dynamic environment where you can apply your skills in content creation, copy editing, and performance analysis to drive AMD’s thought leadership in AI forward. Your proactive approach to marketing ensures that all content is strategic, impactful, and aligned with AMD's goals.
• Content Expert: Proficient in developing thought leadership materials that elevate AMD's presence in the AI space and engage key audiences.
• Precision Editor: Meticulous attention to detail in copy editing and proofreading, ensuring all content meets high standards of clarity and accuracy.
• Strategic Communicator: Skilled at translating complex narratives into compelling marketing messages across various formats.
• Analytical Marketer: Adept at producing detailed reports and ROI calculations, providing insights to refine and enhance marketing strategies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Develop and coordinate AI-focused thought leadership content that aligns with AMD’s strategic goals.
• Translate AMD’s corporate narrative into engaging messaging for blogs, speeches, and reports, both long and short form.
• Copy edit and proofread all related documentation to maintain consistency and accuracy across all marketing materials.
• Produce campaign debriefs and compile regular reports to track performance and calculate ROI, informing future marketing strategies.
• Proactively seek ways to improve all facets of AMD's AI marketing activities, ensuring continuous enhancement in content quality and impact.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
• Proven experience in content marketing and thought leadership within a tech-focused environment.
• Strong background in writing, editing, and content production, particularly related to AI and technology.
• Experience in analyzing marketing data and calculating ROI to assess campaign effectiveness.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining focus on key objectives.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification in a related area is preferred.

job_description:
Zep is building the long-term memory layer for the LLM application stack. With a growing open source community (2K+ ⭐️) and recently launched cloud service, we're seeking an exceptional developer relations engineer to accelerate adoption among developers and help shape our roadmap.

In this highly visible role, you'll engage with the developer community across multiple channels - writing technical content, delivering presentations, creating sample apps/demos, and fielding inquiries. You'll work cross-functionally to deeply understand Zep's products and convey their value propositions.

We are a remote-first organization, but given the gravity of AI community in the SF Bay Area, we strongly prefer you are local or a short plane ride away.

﻿Zep is funded by YC, Engineering Capital, and angels such as Guillermo Rauch (Vercel).

Key Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain relationships with Zep's developer community through online channels, events, and conferences
• Create technical content, including blog posts, tutorials, and documentation, to help developers understand and adopt Zep's technology
• Build proof-of-concept applications and demos showcasing Zep's capabilities and integration with popular LLM frameworks
• Deliver presentations and workshops to educate and inspire developers about Zep's offerings
• Engage with the Zep community to gather feedback, identify pain points, and surface opportunities for improvement
• Collaborate with Zep's product and engineering teams to shape the product roadmap based on community insights
• Monitor and contribute to relevant online communities, forums, and social media channels
• Alongside Daniel (Zep’s founder), represent Zep at industry events, meetups, and hackathons to evangelize our technology and build brand awareness
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Zep's technology, competitive landscape, and target developer personas

Required Skills and Experience:
• 3+ years experience in developer relations, developer advocacy or similar role
• 5+ years software development experience, with Python and TypeScript proficiency
• Background in open source software development and communities
• Hands-on experience building LLM apps with LangChain and other LLM frameworks
• Exceptional technical writing and verbal communication skills
• Ability to build trust and nurture relationships across teams and communities
• Self-motivated with a passion for exploring new technologies
• Based in US, though SF Bay Area is preferred. Willing to travel periodically.

Desired Skills and Experience:

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Our Approach to Work

We lead with flexibility and choice in all of our people programs. We have disrupted the traditional view that all employees have the same needs and wants. We offer personalization and offer our employees the opportunity to choose what works best for them as often as possible - from your wellbeing support to your growth and development, and beyond!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work from the office three days per week, leaving two days for choice and flexibility to work where you feel most effective. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. While details may evolve, our goal is to create an environment where innovation thrives, with office-based teams coming together three days a week to collaborate and thrive, together!

Your Career

Palo Alto Networks is committed to AI security in the emerging AI era. The AI security cloud service engineering team is the core engineering team to build a solid product to assure the runtime security of our customers when they are using AI especially LLM services.

To stay ahead of the curve, it’s critical to know where the curve is, and how to anticipate the changes we may be facing. For the fastest growing cybersecurity company, the curve is the evolution of cyberattacks, and the products and services that proactively address them. We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Generative AI Implementation Specialist (Remote)

Join the Innovation Services Team @ ICF

ICF's Innovation Services Team helps our clients and peers to address complex challenges facing the company, society, and the world. With experts in facilitation, data analytics, solution development, and experience design, we bring a combination of skills and experience that foster ingenuity and catalyze progress.

Both our team and our work are fun and creative. We value psychological safety, diversity, and curiosity, while holding ourselves accountable for results. We collaborate often and build on each other's success. No day, and no challenge, is ever the same, and our mandate and services are continually evolving to meet the changing needs of the teams we serve.

This is a remote position working from anywhere within the US. Occasional travel to ICF and/or client office locations is expected.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking a driven, quick learning Generative AI Implementation Specialist who is interested in using natural language processing and large language models to tackle diverse and complex challenges - you'll consult with stakeholders as well as work in development environments. You will frequently collaborate with others to create, develop, and deploy lasting generative AI solutions for a wide range of problem spaces. You will also interact with stakeholders from different roles and domains to understand their needs, explain technical possibilities and limitations and establish and measure success metrics to enhance the outcomes of solutions. This role focuses on the implementation of models, not the training of novel foundation models.
• Use one or more common NLP/LLM focused languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.) to implement generative AI solutions for various use cases.
• Leverage existing foundation models for implementation and/or fine-tuning.
• Work with data sets of varying sizes, types, and complexities to prepare, process, and analyze them for generative AI solutions.
• Work with stakeholders across a variety of roles and domains to understand their business needs, technical feasibility, and operational constraints.
• Communicate complex technical systems to non-technical staff clearly and concisely.
• Integrate with a cross-functional interdisciplinary team to explore generative artificial intelligence tools and services, supporting a wide range of use cases across ICF.
• Assist in the design, development, and user testing of AI-driven solutions, ensuring their alignment with client needs and project objectives.
• Define, measure, and improve success metrics for generative AI solutions using a metrics-oriented, iterative mindset.

• 0+ years of professional experience.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, and/or technical certifications related to generative AI.
• Knowledge of Python and/or JavaScript development.
• A solid understanding of the basic structure, capabilities, and limitations of foundation models and how they can be applied or adapted for different tasks and domains.

• Experience and interest in incorporating NLP approaches and large language models to solve diverse and complex problems.
• Familiarity with using OpenAI and OpenAI-like (Anthropic, Nvidia NeMo, etc.) API endpoints to access and interact with foundation models.
• Familiarity with vectorization and vector databases.
• Demonstrated skills, certifications, or experience in artificial intelligence.
• Experience working in Azure and/or AWS.
• .NET development experience.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with an exceptional eye for detail.

The Research for Industry (RFI) initiative seeks to identify and accelerate scientific advances in technologies such as data platforms, connectivity, robotics, and AI and bring them to bear on opportunities in a variety of industries, including retail, financial services, energy, and agri-food, and others.

As part of Research for Industry, we work closely with partners, customers, and field experts to enable the data-driven future of different businesses. Role: Solutions Architect with Gen AI

Location: Remote

Experience: Minimum 17+ years in technology development or automation, with a significant focus on AI and machine learning, and at least 5-7 years in business development, solutioning or client-facing roles within the technology sector.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute a comprehensive business development strategy for the organization's generative AI offerings, driving growth and market penetration.

• Lead the generative AI technology unit's market-facing activities, establishing the company as a thought leader and go-to partner in the industry.

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities, leveraging deep knowledge of generative AI to propose solutions that address client needs and create value.

• Oversee the RFP (Request for Proposal) process, from identifying opportunities to crafting compelling proposals that highlight the strengths of the organization's generative AI capabilities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, industry partners, and stakeholders to foster long-term business opportunities and collaborations.

• Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to develop targeted messaging and promotional strategies that effectively convey the benefits of generative AI technologies.

• Provide market insights and competitive analysis to the executive leadership team, informing strategic decision-making and investment in generative AI initiatives.

• Act as the primary liaison between the generative AI technology team and clients, ensuring alignment of technical offerings with market demand and client expectations.

• Drive cross-functional efforts to package generative AI solutions into marketable products or services that deliver measurable business outcomes.

• Coordinate with technical and delivery teams to ensure the successful implementation of generative AI projects, aligning with client objectives and contract specifications.

• Represent the organization at conferences, trade shows, and industry events, articulating the value proposition of generative AI technologies and establishing a strong professional network.

• Educate and advise clients on the potential applications and benefits of generative AI, positioning the organization as a trusted advisor in the field.

• Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes to anticipate market shifts and adjust business development strategies accordingly.

• Work closely with legal and compliance teams to navigate contractual agreements and ensure adherence to industry standards and ethical practices in all business engagements.

• Ability to dissect and understand complex RFP requirements, translating them into detailed technical solutions that leverage generative AI capabilities and align with cloud architectures and best practices.

• Skilled in coordinating with technical subject matter experts to ensure the accuracy and feasibility of proposed generative AI solutions within RFP responses, delivering competitive and compliant bids.

• Proficient in developing comprehensive RFP response strategies that include risk assessment, cost estimation, and technology differentiation, while ensuring adherence to client specifications and industry standards.

• Strong foundation in generative AI technology and its application in various industries, with the ability to translate technical advantages into business benefits.

• Proficiency in crafting technical proposals and delivering presentations that resonate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with the latest trends and innovations in AI, machine learning, and generative models to inform business development activities.

• Understanding of the technical requirements involved in deploying AI solutions, including infrastructure, data management, and compliance considerations.

• Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to conduct market analysis, forecast business potential, and measure the impact of business development efforts.

• Proficient in architecting and proposing cloud-based generative AI solutions, with a deep understanding of cloud services and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) that support scalable, high-performance AI workloads.

• Demonstrated experience in leveraging cloud-native tools for machine learning lifecycle management, including model training, deployment, monitoring, and scaling to meet the dynamic needs of enterprise clients.

• Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a proven track record of nurturing client relationships and closing deals.

• Strategic thinker with a growth mindset, capable of identifying new business opportunities and turning them into successful ventures.

• Outstanding communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts and negotiate contracts.

• Leadership ability to guide cross-functional teams and influence decision-makers both internally and externally.
• • Strong organizational skills, with the capacity to manage multiple projects and proposals concurrently while maintaining attention to detail.

job_description:
We are seeking a dedicated artificial intelligence engineer to join our growing company. You will work as part of a diverse team of software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning (ML) experts to develop new models and algorithms to apply artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems and change the future.

As an artificial intelligence engineer, you will be expected to have a keen interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and staying current with the latest developments in a rapidly changing field. Your duties will include collecting and analyzing data sets to identify patterns and develop predictive algorithmic models.

Do you have an innovative approach to transform mathematics learning and instruction using AI-powered technologies?

AI has the potential to transform mathematics learning and instruction in the K-12 education system for all students, particularly for Black and Latino students and students impacted by poverty, as these communities have historically been excluded in education decisions and solutions design. We are looking to learn about innovative, research-based approaches that leverage AI-powered technologies to revolutionize instructional materials and teacher supports with the potential for scalable impact. We welcome research-backed approaches that support students and/or teachers by:

Students: Increasing student motivation and engagement around mathematics and Improving student learning experiences and outcomes, overall, through instructional materials and tools used in the classroom.

Educators: Increasing teachers’ sustained use of mathematics teaching practices through professional learning tools grounded in instructional materials and/or Augmenting teacher capacity through teacher support tools that save time, cost, and administrative burden.

Creating seamless integration or adoption of high quality instructional materials into mathematics teaching and learning.

Our ultimate goal is to dramatically improve math instruction and learning experiences so that all students are able to deeply understand, use, and enjoy math. Black and Latino students and students impacted by poverty and their teachers are a particular focus because they too often experience access barriers in the K-12 education system to critical resources, such as high-quality curriculum, experienced teachers, and digital innovations.

Why are we doing this Request for Information (RFI)?

The goal of this Request for Information (RFI) is to surface innovative ideas and approaches in the K-12 education field that are exploring or leveraging cutting-edge advancements in AI to dramatically improve mathematics teaching and learning. The aim is to help leaders in K-12 education - district and school leaders, educators, researchers, organization leaders, funders, and others - to have a more complete picture of the work happening in this space. In addition, the K-12 Education team at the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation hopes to draw from these learnings to guide investment strategies and support impactful work.

Potential funding opportunities that may be informed by the responses to this RFI will depend on the fit of submissions. We are particularly interested in hearing from those who directly serve K-12 students and teachers, those who develop products, and/or researchers with approaches to develop, research, or adopt student- and/or teacher-facing AI-powered technologies to improve K-12 math teaching and learning in the U.S. - including those with a specific focus deeply rooted in the needs of Black and Latino students and/or students impacted by poverty and their teachers. We welcome submissions that range from early-stage project concepts to more mature approaches.

Finally, in education, there is a tendency for innovations to be built in silos. Through this RFI (and with specific consent from each respondent) we hope to potentially facilitate connections with other funders and other respondents interested in exploring similar projects.

Job Summary:

Capital One is searching for an applicant for the role of Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to aid in the construction of our enterprise's AI capabilities. You will collaborate with a team of AI engineers and researchers to create strong and secure infrastructure, large-scale distributed training clusters, and sophisticated AI research and development projects. To be successful in this role, you should have extensive knowledge of cloud environments, machine learning, and distributed computing, combined with a passion for transforming the banking sector through innovation.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Build an architecture for strengthening the execution of challenging large-scale training projects with the utilization of containers and checkpointing libraries.
• Designing and deploying an infrastructure capable of serving large machine learning models efficiently is paramount to achieving success in our public cloud environment.
• The public cloud can be effectively utilized to deploy a training cluster that has the potential to dramatically improve the efficiency of training tasks, where special attention is given to refining storage and networking stack for optimal performance.
• Develop benchmark tests that simulate real-world operating conditions and user behaviors to test the performance of AI software systems, and provide recommendations on the most efficient and effective technology stacks for these conditions.

• The candidate possesses significant expertise in developing AI and ML algorithms using either Python or C/C++, honed over half a decade of hands-on experience.

About the role

Gartner’s Consulting business is an extension of Gartner’s industry-leading IT Research. From CIOs, to leaders in business and government, we help Gartner clients across enterprises translate insights into transformational actions and achieve their mission-critical priorities. Leveraging the breadth of Gartner’s resources, Consulting is growing rapidly, with unlimited potential to continue expanding our client base.

Technology Strategy Consulting. We help the C-suite make the right decisions based on how technology can transform their businesses. In today’s world, a consulting firm that is “born digital”, (with the ability to directly leverage the full power of Gartner’s research and insights) has relevance to the most important strategic decisions any business will make.

We deliver value to clients in areas such as IT Strategy Consulting, Benchmarking, Analytics and Optimization. Typically, this helps Gartner’s clients to execute on their strategic priorities, across all sectors, including:
• Digital Growth and Transformation
• Applications, Infrastructure and Security Modernization
• Sourcing and Spent Optimization

The Role:

You will help our clients navigate the complex world of modern AI, data science and analytics. We'll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business perspective on how data science and analytics can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high growth, high visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skillset and build your career.

Chief AI Systems Engineer

Job Summary:

Capital One is searching for an applicant for the role of Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to aid in the construction of our enterprise's AI capabilities. You will collaborate with a team of AI engineers and researchers to create strong and secure infrastructure, large-scale distributed training clusters, and sophisticated AI research and development projects. To be successful in this role, you should have extensive knowledge of cloud environments, machine learning, and distributed computing, combined with a passion for transforming the banking sector through innovation.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Build an architecture for strengthening the execution of challenging large-scale training projects with the utilization of containers and checkpointing libraries.
• Designing and deploying an infrastructure capable of serving large machine learning models efficiently is paramount to achieving success in our public cloud environment.
• The public cloud can be effectively utilized to deploy a training cluster that has the potential to dramatically improve the efficiency of training tasks, where special attention is given to refining storage and networking stack for optimal performance.
• Develop benchmark tests that simulate real-world operating conditions and user behaviors to test the performance of AI software systems, and provide recommendations on the most efficient and effective technology stacks for these conditions.
• Use the insights provided by large language models (LLMs) and feature models (FMs) to craft exceptional applications that are tailored to your target audience's needs.
• Documentation is crucial for effective MLOps for foundation models. Clear and concise documentation can help ensure that team members understand the model's architecture, dependencies, and performance metrics.

Qualifications and Experience:
• This job opportunity calls for candidates who have obtained a technical Bachelor's degree, with preference given to those who studied Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
• I have a wealth of experience in creating and building distributed computing, HPC, and extensive ML systems, spanning over seven years.
• The candidate possesses significant expertise in developing AI and ML algorithms using either Python or C/C++, honed over half a decade of hands-on experience.
• My experience of 3+ years has allowed me to work with artificial intelligence and machine learning frameworks within the context of the public cloud for complete machine learning development.

Preferred Qualifications:
• In order to qualify for this position, candidates must have a Master's or PhD degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or another related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience that emphasizes cutting-edge AI techniques.
• Proficient in building cloud-based distributed systems in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Leveraging their vast experience in cloud systems design, the candidate is highly skilled in developing and implementing cloud architectures that prioritize security, reliability, and scalability while also enforcing cost controls.
• Accomplishing the delivery of large models via the MLOps life cycle is one of our strengths, thanks to our experience and skill.
• The integration of storage and networking components into a GPU cluster hosted in the public cloud can be a complex task, yet the resultant system's efficiency is worth the arduous experience.
• Familiar with the full technology stack for distributed training of expansive models, facilitating distributed training using ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and development libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Lightning and others.
• As an expert in AI technology stack, I am proficient in implementing different areas like prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting, and fine-tuning, helping to achieve better AI outcomes.
• Proven expertise in neural networks, distributed training, and SysML indicated by distinguished research publications presented at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences, or substantial contributions to the industry.

job_description:
R&LS C&OR Ethical AI

Are you looking to make an impact by helping agencies meet their mission goals through successful implementation and operation of their regulatory, mission or compliance programs? Are you ready to help our clients mitigate risks that arise from transformational core business operational change or ongoing operations? Are you interested in helping clients transform how they operate their business to be more effective? If so, Deloitte's Regulatory Compliance team could be the place for you! Our team brings professionals with diverse skillsets including deep experience in industry, AI-enabled data analytics, statistical modeling, and cloud technologies to help our clients preserve their reputation and public trust of their agencies while managing regulatory demands.

Work you'll do
• H elp organizations develop ethical safeguards across six key dimensions of AI: fairness of outcome, model explainability, data privacy and safety, and model quality and governance
• Develop, deploy, and manage AI technologies in a manner that complies with regulatory and ethical principles. This involves considering the potential consequences of AI systems and ensuring that they are designed and used in ways that minimize harm while maximizing the value of providing modeling insights delivered to our clients.
• D evelop and use AI in a way that aligns with commonly accepted qualitative and quantitative regulatory and ethical principles and requirements
• Collaborate with platform engineers, data engineers, system designers, architects, database administrators, and cyber security risk professionals to assist in the overall design of production modeling systems
• D rive the development, ongoing maintenance, and governance of advanced machine learning models and AI pipelines in a growing AI environment
• Work with a team of data scientists, engineers, and model validation professionals in designing and releasing new capabilities to advance data science techniques and improve the trust and transparency in the AI modeling lifecycle
• Interpret and translate model results, metadata, trends, and takeaways to team members, clients, and executive leadership with varying levels of subject matter knowledge
• Support thought leadership on the evolving agenda of AI model governance of overseeing the execution and effectiveness of key modeling governance activities around performance monitoring, testing, and change management in alignment with industry best practices

The team

Deloitte's Government and Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes-is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of over 15,000+ professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

We bring a diverse set of forward thinking capabilities to help agencies proactively manage risks they face in their dynamically changing environments. Our team assesses and transforms the process, controls, and/or infrastructure needed to help our clients address a wide variety of regulatory and compliance risks. We leverage solutions that align to the end-to-end regulatory lifecycle through leveraging AI technology and innovative solutions that incorporate industry as well as domain knowledge.

Are you a problem solver looking to join a dynamic team that utilizes cutting edge approaches and innovative technology to identify and mitigate emerging threats within our client's environment? If you are interested in finding solutions for our clients without the extensive demands of travel, you should consider an opportunity with our US Delivery Center (USDC)! We bring together cohesive teams with a focus on thought diversity and collaborative problem solving to address client challenges efficiently and effectively. The USDC is growing rapidly and we are actively seeking the right professionals to join our team!

• Ability to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role
• Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, or physics
• 6+ years of experience managing and analyzing big data
• Hands-on development experience of AI/ML models, open-source software packages, or cloud AI software
• Experience across the entire model development lifecycle, including interacting with model risk management teams and executing model governance best practices to support trust in AI
• Deep technical understanding, including proficiency in an analytical programming language, such as SAS, Python, or R
• Genuine passion for AI and interest in using machine learning techniques to solve practical business problems and ethical concerns
• A driven self-starter and leader with strong project management skills and proven instances of successfully delivering AI projects and systems
• A team player who can mentor and grow the team around you
• Attentive to detail and quick to adapt to new challenges

Preferred:
• Master's degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative field, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, or physics
• Experience with advanced machine learning techniques and packages (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn, Orange3, SciPy, Matplotlib, Theano)
• Development experience of explainable AI algorithms and frameworks (LIME, SHAP)
• Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE) and/or Agile (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe SM, CSPO)
• Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
• Experience orchestrating MLOps pipelines (MLflow, Kubeflow)
• Experience with designing controls for adversarial machine learning threats
• Published research in the field of AI ethics or AI trust
• Development of AI audit or governance frameworks

How you'll grow

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

job_description:
In Azure Artificial Intelligence (AI), we’re ensuring responsible development and deployment of the next generation of cutting-edge generative AI models like GPT-4. If you join our Responsible AI team, you will join an organization committed to partnering with stakeholders across policy, research, and engineering to help every product team in Microsoft ship these evolving technologies responsibly.

On the Responsible AI team, we work to ensure that each new product or technology we build is developed and used responsibly. As a Principal Product Manager in Responsible AI, you will drive Responsible AI product innovation to design and develop new technologies to address the potential risks of emerging AI and enable developers to successfully and safely use it in real-world applications.

This role requires a deep understanding of generative AI use cases and responsible AI, a keen sense of product to support responsible AI commitments while keeping product innovation in mind, and deep technical background to develop responsible AI measurement and mitigation techniques.

job_title: Principal Product Manager in Responsible AI
job_description:
In Azure Artificial Intelligence (AI), we’re ensuring responsible development and deployment of the next generation of cutting-edge generative AI models like GPT-4. If you join our Responsible AI team, you will join an organization committed to partnering with stakeholders across policy, research, and engineering to help every product team in Microsoft ship these evolving technologies responsibly.

On the Responsible AI team, we work to ensure that each new product or technology we build is developed and used responsibly. As a Principal Product Manager in Responsible AI, you will drive Responsible AI product innovation to design and develop new technologies to address the potential risks of emerging AI and enable developers to successfully and safely use it in real-world applications.

This role requires a deep understanding of generative AI use cases and responsible AI, a keen sense of product to support responsible AI commitments while keeping product innovation in mind, and deep technical background to develop responsible AI measurement and mitigation techniques.

This role is flexible in that you will be able to partner with your Manager to define the way that you’d like to work, whether that is in the office or from home.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Product Manager in Responsible AI, you will build and drive state of the art products that enable customers to apply AI responsibly. Your responsibilities will include:
• Develop a deep understanding of generative AI technology, customer use cases, and responsible AI practices.
• Spend significant time with customers, homing in on successful patterns and trends to drive new product design and development.
• Use creative product thinking to synthesize successful solutions into scalable cloud services.
• Partner closely with engineers and scientists to build models, application programmung interfaces (APIs), services, and complex systems at scale.
• Be an evangelist for the technology – showcasing successful applications with blogs and demos.
• Other: Embody our Culture and Values

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree AND 8+ years experience in product management or software development
• OR equivalent experience.
• 5+ years experience designing and shipping complex products for developers, Machine Learning professionals, or similar.
• 3+ years professional experience in machine learning and/or AI.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred/Additional Qualifications:
• Experience in Responsible AI or Digital Safety or Security
• Experience with Generative AI.
• Deep understanding of Natural Language Understanding/Natural Language Processing/Natural Language Generation (NLU/NLP/NLG) and language models
• Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computational Linguistics or Ethical AI.

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

At Acadia Healthcare, we are at the forefront of technological innovation, leveraging AI to solve real-world problems. Our team is composed of thinkers, creators, and innovators dedicated to making a significant impact in our industry. We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge AI solutions.

As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying artificial intelligence systems that are at the core of our product offerings. You will work closely with a team of data engineers and business stakeholders to create AI models that improve our products and services. Your work will directly contribute to the advancement of our technology and its application in real-world scenarios.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Design, develop, and maintain AI models and algorithms for various applications, including but not limited to machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and identify AI solutions that can enhance product capabilities.
• Conduct data processing and analysis to prepare datasets for training and evaluation of AI models.
• Implement best practices in AI model development, including model validation, testing, and optimization to ensure high performance and scalability.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest AI research and technologies to propose innovative approaches for solving complex problems.
• Document and present model development processes, results, and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Contribute to the company's AI strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities for leveraging AI to achieve business goals.

STANDARD EXPECTATIONS:
• Complies with organizational policies, procedures, performance improvement initiatives and maintains organizational and industry policies regarding confidentiality
• Communicate clearly and effectively to person(s) receiving services and their family members, guests, and other members of the health care team
• Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintains them over time
• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members
• Maintains regular and predictable attendance

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
• Proven experience in AI and data science model development and deployment, with a strong portfolio of projects demonstrating expertise in machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and statistical analysis.

Job Summary:

The Director of Generative AI role at Capital One requires an experienced professional who can lead the development of our Generative AI platform. This job demands supervising a team of AI experts focused on enhancing training pipelines, deploying large ML models, and building scalable infrastructure in the cloud. The successful candidate will have a significant impact on Capital One's goal of transforming the banking industry using the exceptional potential of generative AI.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Organize a team of professionals who will build the foundation of the Generative Artificial Intelligence platform, including AI engineers and scientists.
• In addition to cloud-specific considerations, building and managing large-scale distributed training clusters often requires expertise in machine learning toolkits and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Apache Spark.
• Ensuring the availability and resilience of the infrastructure is paramount when supporting training processes that last for a significant period of time.
• Creating monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the infrastructure runs smoothly and effectively.
• Unleashing the power of our Gen AI platform, we are offering software development kits (SDKs) and application programming interfaces (APIs) to the users. These kits will facilitate them in building novel anomaly/fraud detection systems and information retrieval setups.

Qualifications and Experience:
• The minimum educational requirement is a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• As a seasoned professional who has designed and developed large-scale ML systems for over seven years, I possess the requisite skillset and knowledge to create highly effective solutions.
• As an experienced algorithm developer specializing in AI/ML, I have gained extensive knowledge of Python or C/C++ programming languages over the past six years.
• A proven team leader with extensive experience in managing and guiding teams consisting of engineers and applied scientists.
• With over three years of experience in the AI/ML domain, I have effectively implemented open-source frameworks and public cloud technology to optimize the development process.

Description

Vector Solutions is the leader in providing industry-focused SaaS solutions that connect content and technology. Vector's unique product set aims at training and learning management, continuing education (CE), compliance, workforce scheduling, safety management, and more.

Our mission is to empower everyday heroes in the public, educational and commercial sectors to make safer, smarter, and better decisions.

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary Vice President of Artificial Intelligence to spearhead the transformation of AI implementation for our content solutions and data insight augmentation efforts. At Vector Solutions, our unique product set revolutionizes training and learning management, continuing education (CE), compliance, workforce scheduling, and safety management across commercial, public safety, and education verticals. As we embark on the next frontier of innovation, this pivotal role will lead efforts to strategically implement and integrate cutting-edge AI strategies. Join us in our mission to not only enhance Vector Solutions' position as an industry frontrunner but to redefine the future of SaaS solutions through the power of artificial intelligence.

What You'll Do
• Develop and articulate a comprehensive AI strategy for achieving measurable returns on AI investments across product and verticals.
• Define and drive company-wide AI governance, policies, and guidelines.
• Collaborate with the CPO, CEO, and CTO to ensure alignment between AI strategies and overall business objectives.
• Partner closely with product and development teams, to determine AI integration strategies, prioritize efforts, and drive the design, development, and implementation of AI technologies.
• Facilitate communication between cross-functional teams for a unified approach to AI integration.
• Drive key AI initiatives, providing clear timelines and actionable plans for implementation.
• Regularly report to the executive team and key stake holders on actionable AI initiatives, providing insights into progress, timelines, and expected returns.
• Implement initiatives to gain valuable insights from AI implementation efforts, leveraging data to inform decision-making and improve operational efficiency.
• Utilize AI technologies to enhance content and operational software teams' capabilities, fostering innovation and optimization.
• Collaborate with design and user experience teams to integrate AI in a way that enhances user satisfaction.
• Lead, motivate, and inspire teams to embrace AI technologies and contribute to the organization's overall success.
• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of AI initiatives.
• Continuously monitor and optimize AI models and algorithms to improve performance and reliability.

Requirements
• Master's degree in computer science, AI, data science or related field.
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in AI implementation and strategy with a B2B SaaS organization.
• Expert in modern AI technologies (including generative AI), machine learning models, data analytics, and the underlying infrastructure & engineering to reliably deploy these models at scale.
• Proficient in implementing AI solutions within the context of Vector Solutions' technology stack, using .NET, Java, and SQL Databases.
• Proven track record in recommending effective implementation of solutions that improve functionality, enhance business outcomes, and drive ROI.
• Strong regulatory knowledge of AI, ensuring compliance with industry-specific regulations and standards.
• Established leader with a proven ability to work matrix-style, driving teams and influencing outcomes.
• Demonstrated experience leading people outside of direct lines of reporting.
• Goal-oriented with a clear objective to own the implementation of AI at Vector Solutions.

• Teamwork - Above all, we're a team. We give and value feedback. We support each other, respect each other and work together to accomplish our common goals and serve our customers. Once we make decisions, we align behind them as a team.
• Customers First - Our customers' success is our success. They are why we are here. We work to earn the trust of our customers and always deliver on our commitments.
• Make a Difference - It's not a job, it's a calling. We have passion for our mission, for our customers, for our work, and for sharing a fulfilling experience with our fellow team members.
• Inclusiveness - Uniqueness is powerful. Diversity, equity and inclusion guide how we build our teams and cultivate our leaders, creating a company that promotes a variety of perspectives and crucial conversations, leading to better outcomes.
• Act Now - We act with urgency. The best time to get something important done is now. We don't wait and let perfection be the enemy of good.
• Curiosity - We love a good challenge. We're scrappy, we stretch ourselves to be the best, ask questions, learn from our mistakes, and are dedicated to continually improving and growing.
• Ownership - We own the outcome and don't pass the buck. The score matters. We hold ourselves and each other accountable. We treat company resources like they are our own.

Capital One is searching for an applicant for the role of Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to aid in the construction of our enterprise's AI capabilities. You will collaborate with a team of AI engineers and researchers to create strong and secure infrastructure, large-scale distributed training clusters, and sophisticated AI research and development projects. • The integration of storage and networking components into a GPU cluster hosted in the public cloud can be a complex task, yet the resultant system's efficiency is worth the arduous experience.

Job Description

As a member of the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure(OCI) Enterprise Engineering Content, Search, and AI Services team, responsible for developing, delivering, and supporting major corporate Services and platforms like Oracle.com, Java.com ,my.oracle.com, etc.

As an Enterprise AI Architect, you will craft and steer the adoption and integration of AI, ML, and DevOps practices within complex business domains. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data engineers, developers, operations, IT, and business leadership, to align AI strategies with enterprise goals and aspirations.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Architectural Leadership:

Provide strategic leadership in designing and implementing scalable and secure AI architectures for the Enterprise.

AI Strategy Development:

Collaborate with executive leadership to develop and refine the AI strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices.

Solution Design and Implementation:

Lead the design and implementation of AI solutions, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and frameworks to address complex business challenges. Influence and establish best practices through solid design decisions, processes, and tools. Set goals and strategies and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple technologies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems and processes.

Governance and Compliance:

Establish governance frameworks for AI initiatives, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and industry guidelines.

Scalability and Performance Optimization:

Design scalable solutions optimized for performance and adaptable to evolving business needs.

Emerging Technologies Evaluation:

Stay abreast of emerging AI technologies, assess their potential impact on the enterprise, and make recommendations for adoption by doing rapid prototyping.

Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing:

Provide guidance and mentorship to the AI team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Leading contributors individually and as team members, providing direction and mentoring to others.

Security

Lead various Security and Architecture reviews for complex solutions and integrations for the team.

Work closely with security and risk leaders to foresee and overturn risks, such as training data poisoning, AI model theft, and adversarial samples, ensuring ethical AI implementation and restoring trust in AI systems. Remain acquainted with upcoming regulations and map them to best practices.

Rapid Prototyping

Provide rapid prototyping for various concept projects before they can be prioritized, including developing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying large multimodal language models for retrieval augmented generation. Apply instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning such as p-tuning, adaptors, LoRA, and so on to improve LLMs for different domain-specific RAG use cases. Measure and benchmark models and applications performance.

Qualifications
• Bachelors, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
• 10+ years’ proven experience as an Enterprise Architect, Solution Architect, or a similar role, focusing on AI/ML and generative AI in the last 5+ years.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in building and deploying Machine Learning solutions using various supervised/unsupervised ML algorithms such as Linear/Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, (Deep) Neural Networks, Random Forest, etc., and hands-on experience with Python programming and statistical packages, and ML libraries such as scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MXNet, etc. and/or natural language processing using NLTK, spaCy, Gensim, etc.
• 4+ years of experience in building IT use cases/solutions, especially around AI/ML cognitive services and platforms, Model productionization, ML Ops, CICD Automation, Cloud/On-prem environments,
• Proficient in programming languages such as Python, R, Java, etc.
• Experience working with RAG technologies such as LLM frameworks (Langchain and LLamaIndex), LLM model registries (Hugging Face), LLM APIs, embedding models, and vector databases (FAISS and Milvus).
• Understanding of key libraries used for LLM and RAG development: for NLP models development (e.g., NeMo, DeepSpeed, HuggingFace), for deployment (e.g., TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server) for Information Retrieval (e.g., RAPIDS, Milvus, Pinecone, Open Search).
• Experience working with larger transformer-based architectures for NLP, CV, ASR, or others.
• Experience interacting with REST APIs and microservices.
• Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing concepts, and speech recognition concepts.

• Solid understanding of machine learning principles, including advanced analytics tools, applied mathematics, ML and Deep Learning frameworks and libraries, and ML techniques.
• Proficient in using Jupyter Notebooks for all sorts of data science tasks such as exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning and transformation, data visualization, statistical modeling, machine learning, and deep learning.
• Hands-on experience with cloud-based platforms and services, such as OCI, AWS, GCP, and Azure.

In this capacity, you will be part of a team of AI researchers and engineers, creating robust and secure infrastructures, distributed training clusters, and innovative AI research and development projects. We are seeking candidates with a deep understanding of cloud environments, distributed computing, and machine learning, combined with a passion for advancing the banking industry through cutting-edge technology.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Construct a durable framework capable of managing lengthy, complex training operations, leveraging containers and checkpointing applications.
• Investing in the infrastructure for running large machine learning models is necessary to maintain a competitive edge in the public cloud environment and meet the needs of our customers.
• For organizations looking to optimize their training tasks, deploying a public cloud-based training cluster with a thousand nodes and strategically optimizing the storage and networking structure can enable quicker time-to-result.

• The candidate has been developing AI and ML algorithms in Python or C/C++ for more than 5 years while expanding their expertise base.
• Throughout the last 3 years, my skills and knowledge have expanded in the entire machine learning development process incorporating the public cloud and AI and ML frameworks.

• A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience that centers on modern AI techniques is required for this role.
• Have experience designing large-scale distributed platforms using cloud-based environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• With years of experience architecting cloud solutions for various companies, the candidate brings a unique blend of expertise in providing cost-effective solutions while ensuring adequate security, availability, scalability, and performance.
• We have the capability to handle vast models throughout the MLOps pipeline, including exploratory research and final deployment.
• The creation of GPU clusters in the public cloud environment requires an astute eye for detail, notably in integrating storage and networking functionalities efficiently.
• Adequate experience in utilizing the entire technology stack for distributed training of extensive models, involving various tools and platforms like ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and ML development frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Lightning, etc.

NYC 299 Park Avenue (22957), United States of America, New York, New YorkSenior Lead Engineer - Generative AI Infrastructure (Remote-Eligible)

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Sr. Lead Engineer, Generative AI Infrastructure to help us build the foundations of our AI capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s building large-scale distributed training clusters, or deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time applications and decisioning systems, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with our cloud and container infrastructure teams as well as our world-class team of AI researchers to design and implement key capabilities. Examples of projects you will work on:
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build run-time infrastructure for serving large ML models such as LLMs and FMs in our public cloud.
• Build infrastructure for deploying search indexes and embeddings in vector databases that will work closely with the rest of our capabilities.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 8 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing
• At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
• At least 1 year of experience with HPCs, vector embedding, or semantic search technologies
• At least 1 year of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master's or Doctoral degree in Computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.
• Background in machine learning with experience in large scale training and deployment of deep neural nets and/or transformer architectures.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or Pytorch, Lightning, Mosaic ML etc.
• Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines.

• Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the foundational capabilities.
• Familiarity with deploying large neural network models in demanding production environments.
• Experience with building GPU clusters in the public cloud with tightly-coupled storage and networking.
